author: Kr1ticalKrennic
quote:
The worst gta ever. We asked for realistic physics and graphics, not real life rules. The game was about freedom and doing whatever you want but now there are restrictions on the game which is ironic that you are moral policing in a game about committing crime.
The real issue is that rockstar could've kept all of it and by not letting players do certain acts, they have broken away from the 23 year old tradition that the game is known for.
Jason is a dull protagonist and the gameplay does nothing new in terms of combat. The missions are forgiving to the point that the player is not punished for any mistake. The division is a 2016 game that had better boss fights and you would have been killed if you stayed out of cover for a long time. Taking cover during fight scenes is optional in this game.
I give credit where it is due and that is the graphics of the game and that is phenomenal.
I don't mind the bugs as every game has it on launch but it's the mechanics, the story and the restrictive nature of the game that is a huge disappointment for me.
